es.title: Aprender. Aprehender. (R)Evolucionar.
es.lead: Un método para convertir información en criterio, práctica y conocimiento que puedas explicar.
founder_paragraphs: Creamos MetodologIA para cerrar la distancia entre querer avanzar y saber cómo hacerlo. Aprender no es acumular respuestas: es formular mejores preguntas, trabajar con fuentes y producir evidencia que otra persona pueda revisar.

Empoderamiento, eficiencia, ecosistema y habilitación se encuentran aquí. Este playbook no promete dominio automático; ofrece una estructura para comprender, practicar, comprobar y decidir qué conservar o cambiar.
es.close_title: El método empieza cuando lo usas.
es.close_lead: Elige un tema real, abre el workbook y produce la primera evidencia.

sections.title: Preguntas frecuentes
sections.lead: Respuestas cortas antes de empezar.
items: ¿Necesito pagar? La práctica esencial puede hacerse sin plan pago; condiciones cambian por proveedor.
¿La IA aprende por mí? No. Estructura, propone y ayuda a revisar; la comprensión y la decisión siguen siendo humanas.
¿Puedo usar cualquier fuente? Solo fuentes autorizadas, pertinentes y trazables.
¿Cuándo termino? Cuando la evidencia es suficiente para el propósito y declaras el riesgo residual.

en.title: Learn. Apprehend. (R)Evolve.
en.lead: A method for turning information into judgment, practice and knowledge you can explain.
founder_paragraphs: We created MetodologIA to close the distance between wanting to move forward and knowing how. Learning is not collecting answers; it is asking better questions, working from sources and producing reviewable evidence.
Empowerment, efficiency, ecosystem and enablement meet here. This playbook does not promise automatic mastery; it offers a structure to understand, practise, verify and decide what to keep or change.
en.close_title: The method begins when you use it.
en.close_lead: Choose a real topic, open the workbook and produce the first evidence.

sections.lead: Organise what exists, what you can do and how consistently you can do it.
items: Body of Knowledge: concepts, relationships and sources.

sections.lead: Research begins with the plan, not the tool.
items: Declare purpose, scope, tensions and criteria.

sections.title: Integrity protocol
sections.lead: Trust comes from tracing what supports every claim.
items: Do not invent data or citations.
Do not treat model agreement as independent evidence.
Declare unknowns and stop when authority is missing.

sections.title: (R)Evolve
sections.lead: Reviewing what you learned also means releasing what no longer serves.
items: Keep what remains useful.
Update what is valuable but incomplete.
Replace or retire obsolete knowledge with a documented reason.

sections.title: Learning standards
sections.lead: Practice ends when reviewable evidence exists, not when content was consumed.

sections.title: Essential glossary
sections.lead: Ten concepts for a shared language.
items: Research plan · verifiable questions, sources and criteria.
BoK · a map of knowledge and sources.
Apprehend · retrieve and apply without dependency.
Triangulation · contrast independent evidence.
Sufficiency · evidence adequate to purpose and risk.
Teach-back · explain to reveal understanding.
Skill · reusable instructions and resources for a capability.
Prompt · an executable instruction for AI.
Primary source · evidence close to the fact or authority.
coverage_gap · a declared gap that prevents closure.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
sections.lead: Short answers before you begin.
items: Do I need a paid plan? Essential practice can work without one; provider conditions change.
Does AI learn for me? No. It structures, proposes and supports review; understanding and decisions remain human.
Can I use any source? Only authorised, relevant and traceable sources.
When do I stop? When evidence is sufficient for the purpose and residual risk is declared.

sections.title: Perguntas frequentes
sections.lead: Respostas curtas antes de começar.
items: Preciso pagar? A prática essencial pode funcionar sem plano pago; condições mudam por provedor.

Posso usar qualquer fonte? Apenas fontes autorizadas, relevantes e rastreáveis.
Quando termino? Quando a evidência é suficiente para o propósito e o risco residual foi declarado.
